authority_boundary: GitHub and CI control-plane readback only. Secret values are not accessible and are not retained.

classification.reason: The default branch is protected by an active repository ruleset and required CI checks exist, but repository Actions allow all actions, the spot environment has no protection rules, AWS live workflows are disabled manually, and the organization currently has a single observed admin/member. This is control-plane visibility, not complete corporate recovery or emergency authority proof.

remaining_blockers: Confirm corporate recovery/admin continuity beyond a single observed GitHub admin/member.
Confirm required reviewer/review-thread policy for the repository or record why the active ruleset's PR requirement is sufficient.
Confirm whether repository Actions allowed_actions=all and sha_pinning_required=false are acceptable under company CI policy.
Confirm or enable protection rules for the adl-spot-ci environment before live Spot execution is treated as company-controlled.
Confirm whether manually disabled AWS CodeFriend/Spot workflows are intentional rollback posture or must be re-enabled for availability.
